memoryBuilder.verseText: He is not here, but is risen: remember how he spake unto you when he was yet in Galilee.

sequence.prompt: What is the most important story ever told? Put it in order.

items.label: Jesus dies on the cross for us
Jesus is laid in a tomb
Jesus rises from the dead — alive!

matches.prompt: Match each to what it means for us.

application.question: Jesus rose from the dead — nothing can defeat Him! What does knowing Jesus is alive mean to you?

options.label: I don't have to be afraid
I can have life with God

application.followUp: Because Jesus is alive, death and sin and sadness do not get the last word. He is risen — and that changes absolutely everything, forever.
